title: Firecrawl batch scrape
description: Starts a batch scrape of several pages on the Firecrawl instance (POST /v2/batch/scrape); the answer carries the batch id and its status URL. Nothing is stored by the app. The body is forwarded to Firecrawl unchanged, including options this schema does not list; only apiConfiguration is consumed by the app and not forwarded.

urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Absolute http(s) URLs of the pages to scrape.

formats.title: Formats
formats.description: Output formats, e.g. markdown, html, rawHtml, links, screenshot, summary, or a format object such as {"type": "json", "schema": {...}}. Firecrawl default: ["markdown"].

onlyMainContent.title: Only main content
onlyMainContent.description: Return only the main content of the page, without headers, navigation and footers. Firecrawl default: true.

ignoreInvalidURLs.title: Ignore invalid URLs
ignoreInvalidURLs.description: Skip invalid URLs instead of failing the whole batch; Firecrawl lists them as invalidURLs in its answer.

apiConfiguration.title: Firecrawl connection
apiConfiguration.description: IRI of an active firecrawl connection; its UUID or its name (without spaces) is accepted as well. Omit when exactly one active firecrawl connection exists. The query parameter apiConfiguration wins over this field. Consumed by the app and not forwarded to Firecrawl.
